hooks.command: if [ -n "$NORTHSTAR_TRACE_ID" ]; then curl -s -X POST http://localhost:3000/api/traces -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H "X-Trace-Id: $NORTHSTAR_TRACE_ID" -d "$(cat)" > /dev/null 2>&1; fi

if [ -n "$NORTHSTAR_TRACE_ID" ]; then curl -s -X POST http://localhost:3000/api/traces -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H "X-Trace-Id: $NORTHSTAR_TRACE_ID" -d '{"type":"stop"}' > /dev/null 2>&1; fi
